description: This file defines the NetlinkRequest class, which provides an abstraction for constructing and managing netlink requests used for network interface configuration in Linux. It includes methods for adding interface information, addresses, MAC addresses, and managing nested attribute lists, as well as handling raw data buffers.

classes.name: NetlinkRequest
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the creation and management of netlink requests for network interface configuration.

methods.name: AddString
methods.description: Adds a string attribute to the netlink request with a specified type.

methods.name: AddInt
methods.description: Template method to add an integer attribute to the netlink request.

methods.name: AddIfInfo
methods.description: Adds interface information, including interface index and operational status.

methods.name: AddAddrInfo
methods.description: Adds address information for a specific interface.

methods.name: AddMacAddress
methods.description: Adds a MAC address to the request.

methods.name: PushList
methods.description: Begins a new nested attribute list.

methods.name: PopList
methods.description: Ends the current nested attribute list.

methods.name: RequestData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the constructed request data buffer.

methods.name: RequestLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the request data buffer.

methods.name: SeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the request.

methods.name: AppendRaw
methods.description: Appends raw data to the request buffer.

methods.name: ReserveRaw
methods.description: Reserves space in the request buffer.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Template method to append a specific data type to the request buffer.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Template method to reserve space for a specific data type in the request buffer.
